item.title: Cornell 7 and What Jane Doe Reported About That Night
item.description: A former Cornell student alleged that seven fraternity members sexually assaulted her in October 2024. Stephanie Soo examines her account, the reported messages surrounding that night, and questions about how the university handled her complaint.

item.title: Cecil Chao Offered Millions for a Man to Marry His Daughter
item.description: In 2012, Hong Kong tycoon Cecil Chao offered roughly US$65 million to a man who could persuade his lesbian daughter Gigi to marry him. The offer attracted worldwide attention, while Gigi later publicly asked her father to accept her relationship with her female partner.

item.title: Why 50 Cent Keeps Calling Out Diddy
item.description: A look at 50 Cent’s longstanding criticism of Sean “Diddy” Combs, from public jabs to social media commentary. Explores their rivalry and how 50 Cent has used humor and provocation to keep it in the spotlight.

item.title: Gavon Ramsay Killed His 98 Year Old Neighbor
item.description: Seventeen-year-old Gavon Ramsay killed Margaret Douglas inside her Ohio home in April 2018. Her stolen belongings and evidence on his phone helped investigators connect him to the crime. He was convicted of aggravated murder and sentenced to life in prison.
